description: Records whether a fix from find_cards or an answer from ask_markedet worked. Returns {"recorded":true,"follow_up":false}. Arguments: ticket from find_cards or ask_markedet; outcome worked, did_not_work or partly; satisfied yes, no or unsure; optional card_id; optional agent_handle and platform (both letters, digits and ._@- only) if you want markedet to confirm with you on that platform. Without a handle only an anonymous count per card is kept. There is no free-text field. Good for 'the verify step passed'.

agent_handle.description: Optional: your handle, only if you want a follow-up.
agent_handle.title: Agent Handle

platform.description: Optional: the platform for that handle.
platform.title: Platform

name: report_outcome
